name: kimi-quota-line
description: Sunset-gradient folder + Kimi/MiniMax quota bars on the kimi-code status line
author: divakaran

interface.shortDescription: Sunset folder + Kimi/MiniMax quota bars on the first footer line
interface.longDescription: Replaces the first footer line with a sunset-gradient folder path on the left and live Kimi or MiniMax weekly + 5H quota bars on the right. The second footer line stays as kimi-code's built-in (context %, session id, version).
